page_title: BRE 1-1 LIL | Brest v Lille 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Adam Ounas (Lille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Marco Bizot to dive and make a save.
87' Bradley Locko (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
87' A dangerous looking corner kick from Angel Gomes (Lille) is cleared to safety by the defence.

86' Benjamin Andre (Lille) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Marco Bizot sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
84' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova did his best and is replaced by Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
84' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson makes way for Adam Ounas (Lille).
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Romain Del Castillo will be replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
84' Here is a change. Martin Satriano is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).
79' 1 - 1 Goal! Martin Satriano (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:1.
75' It will be a substitution. Steve Mounie (Brest) is ready to enter the pitch as Mathias Pereira Lage walks off.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
71' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
71' Angel Gomes (Lille) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

71' Jonathan David (Lille) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Marco Bizot pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamory Doumbia (Brest) replacing Mahdi Camara.
68' Substitution. Hugo Magnetti is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).

67' 0 - 1 Goal! Angel Gomes sets up Jonathan David (Lille) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
65' Lucas Chevalier makes a brilliant save! Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
64' Referee Clement Turpin halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Eric Roy, then shows him a yellow.
64' Bradley Locko (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Tiago Santos (Lille) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
59' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
57' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
54' Martin Satriano (Brest) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
53' Mathias Pereira Lage looks up and plays a clever lofted ball onto the head of Martin Satriano (Brest), who sends the ball narrowly wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
50' Unlucky! A great strike from Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
49' The game is interrupted. Hugo Magnetti (Brest) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Clement Turpin with no other option than to blow for a foul.
43' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
36' The game is interrupted as Mahdi Camara (Brest) is flagged offside.
31' Marco Bizot was forced into action to thwart Edon Zhegrova (Lille). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
29' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.

28' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
27' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' Martin Satriano (Brest) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Lucas Chevalier stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
25' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) commits a foul during an attacking move.
25' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' Lilian Brassier (Brest) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Benjamin Andre (Lille) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
19' Leny Yoro (Lille) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Angel Gomes (Lille) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

18' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marco Bizot. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
17' Benjamin Andre (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation.
16' Angel Gomes (Lille) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
12' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
11' Martin Satriano (Brest) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
9' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ismaily (Lille) and blew his whistle.
9' Ismaily (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' The foul by Tiago Santos (Lille) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' Flag up against Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
2' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

1' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin is introduced as the referee for today's match.
